2607.05910.title: PolicyShiftGuard: Benchmarking and Improving Policy-Adaptive Image Guardrails
2607.05910.paper_summary: Image guardrails are typically trained and evaluated under a fixed safety policy, implicitly treating safety as an intrinsic property of an image. Real deployments are different: the same image may be allowed in one product, restricted in another, and newly disallowed when a policy boundary changes. We study policy-adaptive image guardrailing, where a model must decide whether an image violates the currently supplied policy and generalize to held-out policy definitions. We introduce PolicyShiftBench, a comprehensive benchmark with 2,000 policy-discriminative instances over 265 images, where each image is paired with 7.55 policy-conditioned prompts on average to test whether models adapt to the active policy rather than relying on image-level safety priors. We then propose PolicyShiftGuard, a compact policy-conditioned guardrail trained with a two-stage training recipe that combines Randomized Policy SFT (RP-SFT) with Boundary-Pair Policy Adaptation (BP-Adapt). BP-Adapt trains matched prompts for the same image and risk category using standard label supervision and a pairwise comparison loss that separates blocking policies from passing policies. Experiments show that existing VLMs and specialized guardrails remain brittle under policy shifts, while PolicyShiftGuard substantially improves policy-sensitive performance. The 7B model achieves SOTA performance of 76.9 Avg. F1 and 72.1 Avg. PSS on PolicyShiftBench, transfers well to UnSafeBench and SafeEditBench, and improves the latency-performance trade-off with a concise output format. Ablations confirm that matched pass/block boundary pairs are essential for stable policy adaptation.
2607.05910.paper_summary_zh: 影像護欄通常在固定的安全政策下進行訓練和評估，隱含地將安全視為影像的內在屬性。實際部署則有所不同：同一影像在一個產品中可能被允許，在另一個產品中受到限制，並且當政策邊界變更時可能會被新禁止。我們研究政策自適應影像護欄，其中模型必須決定一個影像是否違反當前提供的政策，並對保留的政策定義進行概括。我們介紹了PolicyShiftBench，這是一個綜合基準，包含2,000個政策區分實例，涵蓋265張影像，其中每張影像平均配對7.55個政策條件提示，以測試模型是否適應當前的政策，而不是依賴於影像級別的安全先驗。我們然後提出PolicyShiftGuard，一個緊湊的政策條件護欄，使用兩階段訓練配方進行訓練，將隨機政策SFT (RP-SFT) 與邊界配對政策適應 (BP-Adapt) 結合起來。BP-Adapt使用標準標籤監督和一種成對比較損失來訓練相同影像和風險類別的匹配提示，將阻擋政策與通過政策區分開來。實驗顯示，現有的VLM和專門的護欄在政策變更下仍然脆弱，而PolicyShiftGuard顯著改善了政策敏感性能。7B模型在PolicyShiftBench上達到了76.9的平均F1和72.1的平均PSS的SOTA性能，並且在UnSafeBench和SafeEditBench上表現良好，改善了延遲性能的權衡，使用簡潔的輸出格式。消融實驗確認，匹配的通過/阻擋邊界對於穩定的政策適應至關重要。
